claims: The Artemis II mission uses the Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket stands 322 feet (98 meters) tall.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket is higher than the Statue of Liberty.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket is the most powerful rocket launched with humans.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket produces 8.8 million pounds of thrust using 4 engines and 2 solid boosters.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket weighs 5.75 million pounds (2,604 tonnes) at liftoff.
The Artemis II crew operates inside the Orion capsule.
The Orion capsule features 330 cubic feet (approximately 9 cubic meters) of habitat space.
Orion capsule volume is 330 cubic feet (9.3 m³).
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket is shorter than the 363-foot Apollo-era Saturn V.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket is smaller than SpaceX’s ~400-foot Starship.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket is taller than the 184-foot Space Shuttle.
The Orion capsule is designed to provide room for four astronauts during their 10-day mission around the Moon.
